'''Homing sensors''' were guidance systems used in projectiles such as [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. Located at the tip of the [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], the homing sensor guiding the weapon to its target. Homing [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] were effective against stationary and slow-moving targets, and normally had a margin of error of less that three [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. However, fast-moving [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] could outrun or outmaneuver the missile, making the homing sensors particularly good at targeting [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and bombing runs.<ref name="EGWT" />
